string-array.item: Remember to ask your doctor about prenatal vitamins during your first prenatal visit.
Be sure to run any medication you are currently taking by your doctor at your upcoming visit.
"Ask if you can record your baby's heartbeat at your upcoming doctor's visit."
Be sure to ask your doctor how to most accurately interpret the results, once you receive them, during your First Trimester screening.
"Be sure to talk to your doctor about What happens next? if your results from the Quad screening come back as high risk. "
"Talk to your doctor about safe exercises during pregnancy at your upcoming doctor's visit."
Ask the technician if you can take some of the pictures from your upcoming ultrasound.
"Be sure to ask your doctor if you are gaining the right amount of weight at your upcoming doctor's visit."
Talk to your doctor about any recommended childbirth classes.
"Be sure to talk to your doctor about What happens next? if your results from the Quad screening come back as high risk. "
Talk to your doctor about your birth plan at your upcoming visit.
Ask your doctor if you can meet their back-up practitioners
Ask your doctor or midwife if you can see the hospital or birthing center.
Be sure to ask your doctor if sex is okay during this final month.
Talk to your doctor about when you should call if labor starts.
